Summary: Gate submission by rules acceptance and consent
Description: As a candidate, I can only submit when acceptedRegulationVersion, acceptedRegulationAt, and lgpdConsentAccepted are valid.

Summary: Block duplicates by canonical email and WhatsApp
Description: As operations, I need deterministic duplicate blocking to keep the queue clean and prevent repeated candidate intake.
As operations, I receive only review-ready candidate applications with required fields and compliance evidence.
As a reviewer, I can approve or reject only when authenticated and authorized.

Summary: Enforce lifecycle guards on review actions
Description: As operations, review decisions are valid only for SUBMITTED or UNDER_REVIEW states.

Summary: Set deterministic retention cutoff for rejections
Description: As governance owner, rejected applications always store retentionUntil = reviewedAt + 365 days.
As product owner, I monitor daily submissions and funnel conversion to assess onboarding health.

Summary: Track review latency and backlog risk
Description: As operations lead, I monitor time-to-review and queue accumulation for staffing and policy decisions.
As engineering lead, I need observability alignment checks to catch missing or mismatched instruments.
